CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #3
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   B. Pollute rivers deliberately
   C. Destroy trees without planting
   D. Waste food daily

2. Which response best shows understanding of Methods of Studying the Holy Bible? (1 mark)
   A. Say Methods of Studying the Holy Bible has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Methods of Studying the Holy Bible.
   C. Apply the teaching of Methods of Studying the Holy Bible with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Methods of Studying the Holy Bible to insult classmates of other faiths.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Principles of Good Stewardship? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Principles of Good Stewardship with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Principles of Good Stewardship has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Principles of Good Stewardship.
   D. Use Principles of Good Stewardship to insult classmates of other faiths.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Selected Judges? (1 mark)
   A. Say Selected Judges has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected Judges.
   C. Use Selected Judges to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Selected Judges with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Conquest and settlement in Canaan? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Conquest and settlement in Canaan with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Conquest and settlement in Canaan has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Conquest and settlement in Canaan.
   D. Use Conquest and settlement in Canaan to insult classmates of other faiths.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Journey to Jerusalem Parables on Prayer? (1 mark)
   A. Use Journey to Jerusalem Parables on Prayer to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Journey to Jerusalem Parables on Prayer with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Journey to Jerusalem Parables on Prayer has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Journey to Jerusalem Parables on Prayer.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Writing the Holy Bible? (1 mark)
   A. Say Writing the Holy Bible has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Writing the Holy Bible.
   C. Apply the teaching of Writing the Holy Bible with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Writing the Holy Bible to insult classmates of other faiths.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Journey to Jerusalem The Way of Salvation? (1 mark)
   A. Say Journey to Jerusalem The Way of Salvation has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Journey to Jerusalem The Way of Salvation to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Journey to Jerusalem The Way of Salvation.
   D. Apply the teaching of Journey to Jerusalem The Way of Salvation with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Journey to Jerusalem True Discipleship? (1 mark)
   A. Say Journey to Jerusalem True Discipleship has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Journey to Jerusalem True Discipleship with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Journey to Jerusalem True Discipleship to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Journey to Jerusalem True Discipleship.

10. Which response best shows understanding of Journey to Jerusalem? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Journey to Jerusalem with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Journey to Jerusalem has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Journey to Jerusalem to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Journey to Jerusalem.

11. Which response best shows understanding of Journey to Jerusalem:? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Journey to Jerusalem:.
   B. Apply the teaching of Journey to Jerusalem: with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Journey to Jerusalem: has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Journey to Jerusalem: to insult classmates of other faiths.

12. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   B. Refusing to help a neighbour
   C. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   D. Skipping all moral lessons

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Prophet Jeremiah and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Journey to Jerusalem True Discipleship and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Journey to Jerusalem and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Journey to Jerusalem: and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
